sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing. sources.title: byt5-small: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview byt5-small is a tokenizer-free text-to-text model maintained by google that operates directly on raw UTF-8 bytes rather than tokens. Built on a standard Transformer encoder-decoder architecture based on T5, this model was pre-trained exclusively on the multilingual mC4 dataset using byte-level span masking with an average mask length of 20 UTF-8 characters.
